run.title: CRM Vendor Selection and Contracting
run.objective: Select and contract a new CRM vendor for our 40-person sales team within three weeks.
run.summary: Evaluate, select, and contract a new CRM vendor supporting Arabic, WhatsApp integration, and KSA data hosting within the 180,000 SAR annual budget for a 40-person sales team.

tasks.title: Evaluate Vendor Proposals
tasks.description: Analyze the three attached vendor proposals against requirements: Arabic support, WhatsApp integration, KSA data hosting, and the 180,000 SAR annual budget ceiling.

Compliance with Arabic, WhatsApp, KSA hosting, and budget is explicitly checked.

tasks.title: Select Preferred CRM Vendor

Selection rationale is approved by the Sales and Procurement leads.

tasks.title: Draft Commercial Contract and SLA

acceptanceCriteria: Contract draft includes agreed pricing within the 180,000 SAR ceiling.
SLA covers uptime and support requirements.

tasks.title: Financial Review and Budget Approval

acceptanceCriteria: Contract cost is formally approved for signing.

tasks.title: Sign Vendor Contract

routing.rationale: Signing a legal contract requires human authority.

acceptanceCriteria: Specifies all required integration endpoints and data mapping

### CRM Vendor Evaluation Matrix

**To:** Lina Bakr, Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi
**From:** Majed Al-Ghamdi, Procurement Manager

| Criteria | Vendor A (CloudCore) | Vendor B (SalesFlow) | Vendor C (OmniCRM) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Arabic Support** | Native/Full | Partial | Full |
| **WhatsApp Integration** | Native API | Third-party plugin | Native API |
| **KSA Data Hosting** | Yes (Local DC) | No (Global Cloud) | Yes (Local DC) |
| **Annual Cost (SAR)** | 165,000 | 140,000 | 195,000 |
| **Budget Compliance** | Pass | Pass | Fail |
| **Requirement Status** | **Compliant** | **Non-Compliant** | **Non-Compliant** |

---

### Compliance Summary

1.  **Vendor A (CloudCore):** Meets all technical and regional requirements. The annual cost of 165,000 SAR is within the 180,000 SAR budget ceiling. This vendor is recommended for the next stage of procurement.
2.  **Vendor B (SalesFlow):** Fails the KSA data hosting requirement. While the price is attractive, it does not meet our mandatory regulatory infrastructure standards.
3.  **Vendor C (OmniCRM):** Meets all technical requirements, including native Arabic support and KSA hosting. However, the annual cost of 195,000 SAR exceeds the budget ceiling by 15,000 SAR (assumption: price is fixed).

### Recommendations

*   **Proceed with Vendor A:** Initiate a technical deep-dive and security assessment with CloudCore, as they are the only vendor to satisfy all mandatory criteria within the budget.
*   **Negotiation Strategy:** Should we prefer the features of Vendor C, I recommend opening price negotiations to bring the annual cost below the 180,000 SAR threshold.
*   **Next Steps:**
    *   **Lina Bakr:** Confirm if the feature set of Vendor A meets the specific operational needs of the 40-person sales team.
    *   **Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi:** Review the provided cost breakdown for Vendor A to ensure no hidden implementation fees exist.

Majed Al-Ghamdi
Procurement Manager

deliverables.content:
**To:** Majed Al-Ghamdi (Procurement Manager), Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi (Finance Manager)
**From:** Lina Bakr, Head of Sales
**Subject:** Selection of Preferred CRM Vendor: CloudCore

Following the review of the CRM evaluation matrix, I have formally selected **CloudCore** as our preferred vendor for the 40-person sales team.

### Selection Rationale
CloudCore is the only vendor that satisfies all mandatory operational and regulatory requirements while remaining within our defined financial constraints:

1.  **Regulatory Compliance:** It provides the required data hosting within Saudi Arabia, ensuring we meet local data sovereignty standards.
2.  **Operational Capability:** It offers native Arabic support and native WhatsApp integration, both of which are critical for our team’s daily workflows and customer engagement.
3.  **Budget Alignment:** The annual cost of 165,000 SAR is 15,000 SAR under our 180,000 SAR budget ceiling, allowing for potential training or minor configuration adjustments (assumption).

### Approval Request
As this selection aligns with our procurement and sales objectives, I request your formal approval to proceed with the next stages:

*   **Procurement (Majed Al-Ghamdi):** Please initiate the technical deep-dive and security assessment as outlined in your recommendation.
*   **Finance (Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi):** Please verify the final cost structure to ensure no hidden implementation fees exist before we move toward contracting.

We will proceed with CloudCore as the primary partner, provided the technical assessment confirms the platform's stability and performance requirements.

Regards,

Lina Bakr
Head of Sales

# CRM Vendor Selection Scorecard and Approval Request

**To:** Lina Bakr (Head of Sales), Majed Al-Ghamdi (Procurement Manager), Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi (Finance Manager)  
**From:** Lina Bakr, Head of Sales  
**Date:** October 24, 2023 (assumption)  
**Subject:** CRM Vendor Selection & Formal Approval Request  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Following a comprehensive evaluation of three CRM vendor proposals for our 40-person sales team, this document establishes the formal selection rationale and requests the joint approval of the Head of Sales and the Procurement Manager. 

The evaluation measured all vendors against our mandatory criteria: native Arabic support, native WhatsApp integration, KSA data residency, and a strict annual budget ceiling of 180,000 SAR.

---

## 2. Vendor Evaluation Matrix

| Criteria | Vendor A (CloudCore) | Vendor B (SalesFlow) | Vendor C (OmniCRM) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Arabic Support** | Native/Full | Partial | Full |
| **WhatsApp Integration** | Native API | Third-party plugin | Native API |
| **KSA Data Hosting** | Yes (Local DC) | No (Global Cloud) | Yes (Local DC) |
| **Annual Cost (SAR)** | 165,000 | 140,000 | 195,000 |
| **Budget Compliance** | Pass (Within 180k limit) | Pass (Within 180k limit) | Fail (Exceeds 180k limit) |
| **Final Status** | **Selected** | **Rejected** | **Rejected** |

---

## 3. Selection Rationale

*   **Vendor A (CloudCore) – Recommended:** CloudCore is the only vendor that successfully satisfies all mandatory operational, regulatory, and financial requirements. It provides native Arabic support, native WhatsApp integration, local KSA data hosting, and an annual subscription cost of 165,000 SAR, which is comfortably within our 180,000 SAR budget ceiling.
*   **Vendor B (SalesFlow) – Eliminated:** While priced attractively at 140,000 SAR, Vendor B fails the mandatory KSA data hosting requirement by utilizing global cloud infrastructure, violating regional compliance policies. Furthermore, it offers only partial Arabic support and relies on third-party plugins for WhatsApp.
*   **Vendor C (OmniCRM) – Eliminated:** Although Vendor C meets all technical and regional hosting specifications, its annual cost of 195,000 SAR exceeds the budget ceiling by 15,000 SAR (assumption: no discounting available).

---

## 4. Formal Approval Section

By signing below, the Sales Lead and Procurement Manager approve the selection rationale and authorize proceeding to contract negotiations and implementation planning with **Vendor A (CloudCore)**.

### Sales Lead Approval
* **Name:** Lina Bakr  
* **Title:** Head of Sales  
* **Signature:** ___________________________  
* **Date:** ____ / ____ / 2023  

### Procurement Manager Approval
* **Name:** Majed Al-Ghamdi  
* **Title:** Procurement Manager  
* **Signature:** ___________________________  
* **Date:** ____ / ____ / 2023  

---

Lina Bakr  
Head of Sales

# COMMERCIAL SERVICES AGREEMENT

**This Commercial Services Agreement** ("Agreement") is entered into as of November 1, 2023 (the "Effective Date") (assumption), by and between:

1. **The Client**: The organization represented by Majed Al-Ghamdi, Procurement Manager, located in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia ("Client"), and
2. **The Vendor**: CloudCore Inc., a provider of customer relationship management software and services ("Vendor").

---

### 1. Scope of Services
Vendor agrees to provide the Client’s 40-person sales team with access to the CloudCore CRM platform, including native Arabic support, native WhatsApp integration, and associated implementation, training, and maintenance services as outlined in the Vendor Proposal.

### 2. Financial Terms and Pricing
* **Annual Subscription Fee**: 165,000 SAR (One Hundred Sixty-Five Thousand Saudi Riyals) per year.
* **Budget Ceiling Compliance**: The total annual contract value of 165,000 SAR is fully compliant with and strictly within the Client's 180,000 SAR annual budget ceiling.
* **Payment Schedule**: Payable in equal semi-annual installments of 82,500 SAR net 30 days from invoice date (assumption).
* **Taxes**: All fees are exclusive of applicable Value Added Tax (VAT), which shall be added as required by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

### 3. Term and Termination
* **Initial Term**: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall remain in full force and effect for a period of twelve (12) months.
* **Renewal**: Automatically renews for successive one-year terms unless written notice of non-renewal is provided by either party at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the current term.
* **Termination for Cause**: Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice if the other party materially breaches any provision and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days of receiving written notice.

### 4. Data Hosting and Sovereignty
* **Data Residency**: Vendor explicitly guarantees that all Client data, including customer records, sales pipelines, and communication logs, shall be stored and processed exclusively within a local data center located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, fully complying with regional regulatory requirements.

---

# SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT (SLA)

This Service Level Agreement ("SLA") is attached to and made an integral part of the Commercial Services Agreement between the Client and Vendor.

### 1. System Availability and Uptime
* **Uptime Commitment**: Vendor guarantees a monthly System Uptime of 99.9%, excluding scheduled maintenance.
* **Scheduled Maintenance**: Maintenance windows shall be scheduled outside of standard KSA business hours (Sunday to Thursday, 08:00 to 18:00 AST) and communicated at least forty-eight (48) hours in advance.
* **Uptime Credits**: In the event that monthly uptime falls below 99.9%, the Client shall receive a service credit calculated as 10% of the monthly equivalent fee for each full percentage point of downtime below the threshold, up to a maximum of 50% of the monthly fee.

### 2. Support and Incident Management
Vendor shall provide technical support services to the Client's 40-person sales team in accordance with the following severity levels and response times:

* **Severity 1 (Critical)**: Complete system outage, data corruption, or inability to access the CRM platform impacting all users.
  * *Response Time*: Within 15 minutes.
  * *Resolution Target*: Continuous work until resolution (maximum 4 hours).
* **Severity 2 (High)**: Major feature failure (e.g., WhatsApp integration offline, Arabic text rendering critical error) impacting multiple users without a workaround.
  * *Response Time*: Within 1 hour.
  * *Resolution Target*: Within 8 business hours.
* **Severity 3 (Medium/Low)**: Minor bugs, general usage questions, or feature requests.
  * *Response Time*: Within 4 business hours.
  * *Resolution Target*: Within 24 business hours.

### 3. Support Channels
* Dedicated support portal, email ticketing, and telephone support available during KSA business hours, with 24/7 coverage specifically for Severity 1 incidents.

---

### Signatures

**For the Client:**  
Majed Al-Ghamdi  
Procurement Manager  
[Signature provided by Majed Al-Ghamdi]  
Date: November 1, 2023 (assumption)  

**For the Vendor:**  
[Vendor Authorized Representative Name] (assumption)  
[Vendor Title] (assumption)  
[Signature provided by Vendor] (assumption)  
Date: November 1, 2023 (assumption)

# Commercial Services Agreement and Service Level Agreement (Draft)

**Prepared by:** Majed Al-Ghamdi, Procurement Manager  
**Reviewed by:** Lina Bakr (Head of Sales), Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi (Finance Manager) (assumption)  
**Vendor:** CloudCore  

---

## Part 1: Commercial Contract Terms

### 1. Parties and Purpose
This Commercial Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between the Client and CloudCore ("Vendor"), for the provision of a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software solution tailored for the Client's 40-person sales team.

### 2. Scope of Services & Mandatory Specifications
The Vendor shall provide a cloud-based CRM software platform that strictly meets the following operational and regulatory requirements:
*   **Arabic Support:** Full native Arabic language interface and text handling capabilities.
*   **WhatsApp Integration:** Native API integration for WhatsApp messaging directly within the CRM platform.
*   **Data Residency:** 100% of Client data must be hosted and stored locally within data centers located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA).

### 3. Financial Terms and Pricing
*   **Annual Subscription Fee:** The total annual cost for the CRM software license and associated services is 165,000 SAR (inclusive of all applicable local taxes) (assumption).
*   **Budget Compliance:** This agreed fee complies fully with the Client's maximum annual budget ceiling of 180,000 SAR.
*   **Payment Schedule:** Payment shall be made annually in advance upon receipt of a verified invoice approved by the Client's Finance Manager (assumption).

### 4. Term and Termination
*   **Initial Term:** This Agreement shall commence on the effective date of deployment and shall remain in effect for a period of twelve (12) months (assumption).
*   **Renewal:** The Agreement may be renewed for subsequent one-year terms upon mutual written agreement of both parties at least thirty (30) days prior to expiration (assumption).
*   **Termination for Convenience:** The Client may terminate this Agreement for any reason by providing thirty (30) days written notice to the Vendor (assumption).

---

## Part 2: Service Level Agreement (SLA)

### 1. Purpose and Scope
This Service Level Agreement defines the core service standards, system availability commitments, and support response times provided by CloudCore during the term of the Commercial Services Agreement.

### 2. System Uptime and Availability
*   **Uptime Commitment:** The Vendor guarantees a system availability uptime of 99.9% during each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance windows (assumption).
*   **Scheduled Maintenance:** Maintenance shall be performed during off-peak hours (e.g., Fridays between 01:00 AM and 05:00 AM KSA time) with a minimum of forty-eight (48) hours advance notice provided to the Client (assumption).
*   **Uptime Penalties:** In the event that monthly uptime falls below 99.9%, the Client shall be eligible for service credits applied to the subsequent billing cycle, calculated as a proportionate refund of the monthly subscription value (assumption).

### 3. Technical Support and Incident Management
The Vendor shall provide tiered technical support services to ensure continuous operational readiness for the 40-person sales team. Support requests shall be categorized and addressed according to the following service levels:

*   **Severity 1 (Critical - Complete System Outage / Data Loss):**
    *   *Description:* Production system is down, or critical features (such as WhatsApp integration or Arabic UI rendering) are entirely unusable.
    *   *Initial Response Time:* Within 15 minutes (assumption).
    *   *Resolution Target:* Continuous workaround or resolution within 2 hours (assumption).

*   **Severity 2 (High - Impaired Functionality):**
    *   *Description:* Major functionality is degraded, but the system remains operational for the sales team.
    *   *Initial Response Time:* Within 1 hour (assumption).
    *   *Resolution Target:* Resolution within 6 hours (assumption).

*   **Severity 3 (Normal - General Inquiry / Minor Issue):**
    *   *Description:* General user questions, minor UI glitches, or non-urgent configuration requests.
    *   *Initial Response Time:* Within 4 hours (assumption).
    *   *Resolution Target:* Resolution within 24 hours (assumption).

### 4. Support Channels and Availability
*   **Hours of Operation:** Technical support shall be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, via dedicated ticketing portal, email, and telephone support channels (assumption).
*   **Language Support:** Support communications and technical documentation shall be provided in both Arabic and English.

ERP Integration Requirements Specification

Document Type: Technical Requirements Specification (Draft)

Sender / Procurement: Majed Al-Ghamdi (Procurement Manager)

Project Stakeholders: Lina Bakr (Head of Sales), Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi (Finance Manager)

Target CRM Vendor: Vendor A (CloudCore)

Scope: CRM and ERP Integration Points, Data Flows, and Security Standards

1. Introduction and Objectives

This technical specification outlines the required integration architecture between the newly selected CRM platform (Vendor A - CloudCore) and the corporate Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. The integration ensures seamless data synchronization for the 40-person sales team, maintaining financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and strict adherence to regional compliance policies.

2. Integration Endpoints and Data Mapping

To facilitate bi-directional communication between the CRM and ERP systems, the following primary integration endpoints and data mapping rules must be established:

Integration Point Direction Trigger Event Data Mapping Requirements
Customer / Account Master Bi-directional Account creation or update in CRM / ERP Company Name, Tax ID, Billing Address, Shipping Address, Credit Limit, Payment Terms.
Product Catalog & Pricing ERP to CRM Catalog update in ERP SKU ID, Item Description, Unit Price, Tax Category, Inventory Availability Levels.
Sales Quotations CRM to ERP Quote status changed to "Won / Approved" Quote ID, Customer ID, Line Items, Quantities, Agreed Pricing, Discounts, Sales Rep ID.
Sales Orders & Invoicing Bi-directional Order conversion / Invoice generation Order ID, ERP Invoice ID, Payment Status, Delivery Status, Aging Details.

3. Data Flows and Synchronization Architecture

  • Synchronization Frequency: Master data (Products, Accounts) will sync on a scheduled batch basis (hourly), while transactional data (Quotations, Orders) will utilize real-time Webhooks/API calls to ensure immediate processing.
  • Error Handling & Logging: Failed API transactions must be logged in an integration middleware queue with automated email alerts dispatched to the IT and Finance teams (Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi).
  • Language and Localization Support: Data flows must fully support UTF-8 encoding to accurately transmit and store Arabic character sets across both CRM and ERP environments.

4. Security and Authentication Requirements

Given the sensitivity of financial and customer data, the integration architecture must enforce rigorous security standards:

  • Authentication Protocol: All API requests between the CRM and ERP must use OAuth 2.0 token-based authentication with restricted scopes and automated token rotation.
  • Data Encryption: All data in transit must be encrypted using TLS 1.3. Data at rest within integration staging databases must be encrypted using AES-256.
  • Data Residency Compliance: In alignment with regional regulatory requirements, all integration endpoints, middleware logs, and data sync caches must reside strictly within data centers located in Saudi Arabia (KSA).
  • Access Control: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) must be implemented to restrict API integration permissions strictly to designated service accounts.
Status Notice: This document represents a draft specification prepared by Procurement (Majed Al-Ghamdi) for review by Sales and Finance stakeholders. Final architectural implementation and vendor deployment depend on formal technical validation provided by the project team.

# Commercial Services Agreement and Service Level Agreement (Updated)

**Prepared by:** Majed Al-Ghamdi, Procurement Manager  
**Reviewed by:** Lina Bakr (Head of Sales), Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi (Finance Manager) (assumption)  
**Vendor:** CloudCore  

---

## Part 1: Commercial Contract Terms (Summary)
*   **Scope:** CRM software for 40-person team with Arabic support, WhatsApp integration, and KSA data residency.
*   **Financials:** 165,000 SAR annual fee (Budget ceiling: 180,000 SAR).
*   **Terms:** 12-month initial term; 30-day termination for convenience.

---

## Part 2: Service Level Agreement (SLA) & ERP Integration

### 1. System Uptime and Availability
*   **Uptime Commitment:** The Vendor guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime for both the CRM platform and the ERP integration API.
*   **Penalties for Downtime:** Should uptime fall below 99.9%, the Client shall be entitled to a service credit of 5% of the monthly subscription fee for every 0.1% of downtime, capped at 25% of the monthly fee.

### 2. ERP Integration Support Terms
*   **Integration Availability:** The Vendor shall maintain continuous API connectivity between the CRM and the Client’s ERP system.
*   **Support Response Times:**
    *   **Critical Failures (Integration Down):** Response within 1 hour; resolution within 4 hours.
    *   **High Priority (Data Sync Errors):** Response within 4 hours; resolution within 1 business day.
*   **Reporting:** Vendor must provide monthly performance reports detailing integration uptime and latency metrics.

---

# اتفاقية الخدمات التجارية واتفاقية مستوى الخدمة (محدثة)

**إعداد:** ماجد الغامدي، مدير المشتريات  
**مراجعة:** لينا بكر (رئيسة المبيعات)، عبد العزيز المطيري (مدير المالية) (افتراض)  
**المورد:** CloudCore  

---

## الجزء الأول: شروط العقد التجاري (ملخص)
*   **النطاق:** نظام CRM لفريق مبيعات مكون من 40 شخصاً مع دعم اللغة العربية، تكامل واتساب، واستضافة البيانات داخل المملكة العربية السعودية.
*   **المالية:** 165,000 ريال سعودي سنوياً (سقف الميزانية: 180,000 ريال سعودي).
*   **الشروط:** مدة أولية 12 شهراً؛ إمكانية الإنهاء لأي سبب مع إشعار قبل 30 يوماً.

---

## الجزء الثاني: اتفاقية مستوى الخدمة (SLA) وتكامل نظام ERP

### 1. وقت التشغيل وتوافر النظام
*   **التزام وقت التشغيل:** يضمن المورد وقت تشغيل بنسبة 99.9% شهرياً لكل من منصة CRM وواجهة برمجة تطبيقات (API) تكامل نظام ERP.
*   **غرامات التوقف:** في حال انخفض وقت التشغيل عن 99.9%، يحق للعميل الحصول على رصيد خدمة بنسبة 5% من رسوم الاشتراك الشهري مقابل كل 0.1% من وقت التوقف، بحد أقصى 25% من الرسوم الشهرية.

### 2. شروط دعم تكامل نظام ERP
*   **توافر التكامل:** يلتزم المورد بالحفاظ على اتصال مستمر (API) بين نظام CRM ونظام ERP الخاص بالعميل.
*   **أوقات الاستجابة للدعم:**
    *   **الأعطال الحرجة (توقف التكامل):** الاستجابة خلال ساعة واحدة؛ الحل خلال 4 ساعات.
    *   **الأولوية العالية (أخطاء مزامنة البيانات):** الاستجابة خلال 4 ساعات؛ الحل خلال يوم عمل واحد.
*   **التقارير:** يجب على المورد تقديم تقارير أداء شهرية توضح وقت تشغيل التكامل ومقاييس التأخير.

---

**Majed Al-Ghamdi**  
Procurement Manager

report.en: Status Report: We successfully selected and contracted a new CRM vendor for our sales team within the budget and ahead of schedule, completing the project on day three of our fifteen-day deadline. The digital agents evaluated proposals, drafted contracts, and prepared integration specifications. Our team members, including Lina Bakr, Abdulaziz Al-Mutairi, and Majed Al-Ghamdi, selected the vendor, approved the budget, and finalized the legal agreements. Key decisions involved ensuring no placeholder text or premature signatures were included by the agents, and requiring human approval for contract changes. There are no current risks, and the next steps are to begin the system implementation.
report.ar: تقرير الحالة: لقد نجحنا في اختيار التعاقد مع مورد نظام علاقات عملاء جديد لفريق المبيعات ضمن الميزانية وقبل الموعد المحدد، حيث أتممنا المشروع في اليوم الثالث من مهلتنا المكونة من خمسة عشر يوماً. قامت الوكلاء الرقميون بتقييم العروض وصياغة العقود وتجهيز مواصفات التكامل. كما قام فريقنا باختيار المورد، واعتماد الميزانية، ووضع اللمسات الأخيرة على الاتفاقيات القانونية. تضمنت القرارات الرئيسية ضمان خلو العقود من أي نصوص مؤقتة أو توقيعات مبكرة، وضرورة موافقة شخصية على التعديلات القانونية. لا توجد مخاطر حالية، والخطوة التالية هي البدء بتنفيذ النظام.
